What does the Bible say about anxiety? Philippians 4:6–7:

“In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.”

Paul doesn’t say “stop feeling anxious.” He gives you something to do with it: turn each worry into a prayer, and say thank you while you wait.

More Bible verses for anxiety, plus a short prayer, from Worship Room: worshiproom.com/guides/bible-verses-about-anxiety

Psalm 23 is one of the most loved passages in the Bible. Here are its first three verses:

“Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.” Psalm 23:1–3

What does Psalm 23 mean? Worship Room walks through it verse by verse, from the still waters to the valley of the shadow of death: worshiproom.com/guides/psalm-23-meaning

#psalm23 #bibleverse #scripture

What to pray when you can’t sleep: one verse and one short prayer for tonight.

“In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.” Psalm 4:8

A prayer for tonight: Lord, my thoughts are running in circles. I can’t solve any of this tonight, and I don’t have to. I’m setting each one down in front of You. Quiet my mind and let me rest.

More short prayers for sleepless nights, from Worship Room: worshiproom.com/guides/what-to-pray-when-you-cant-sleep

Bible verses about fear: Isaiah 41:10 holds five promises in one verse. I am with you. I am your God. I will strengthen you. I will help you. I will uphold you.

“Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.” Isaiah 41:10

Save this for a day you need it. More verses about fear and courage, plus a prayer for when you’re afraid, from Worship Room: worshiproom.com/guides/bible-verses-about-fear
